Name: Ali's Farm map edit 1.1 UPDATED
Author: strawberrymilk95
Description:
as requested i've uploaded my farm map edit! all grass is tillable and it adds a little river and a fountain area. NOTE: the fences on your farm won't appear as picket fences because i've edited the outdoors tile sheet for my game.

UPDATES:

-fixed some issues including not being able to interact with lumberpile
-added different versions 
    -3 bridges
    -versions without the fountains and gravestones

[b]1.1 UPDATE[/b]

-updated to 1.1
-fixed bugs

[b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS[/b]

I've put all 4 farm versions (3 vs 1 bridge and clean vs cluttered) into one rar file. unzip the rar file and choose ONE farm map (there are png images to show you what each one looks like) and rename it to Farm.xnb and place in your Content\Maps folder. I recommend you backup your original Farm.xnb file first by naming it Farm_backup.xnb or something like that.
